{{Top|leg}}
A tracking camera was a [[Camera/Legends|camera]] device on the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] which allowed the user to observe the surfaces of nearby planets. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] used the tracking camera to observe the lower levels of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] to locate the missing [[Wookiee]] [[Lumpawaroo/Legends|Lumpawarrump]], after his mother, [[Mallatobuck/Legends|Mallatobuck]] sent thought-waves to [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], who was on the ''Millennium Falcon'', to tell him that Lumpawarrump was missing. Solo adjusted the dials, buttons, and knobs of the tracking camera and aimed the camera until the lower levels of Kashyyyk came into view on the viewscreen.<ref name="The Wookiee Storybook">''[[The Wookiee Storybook]]''</ref>
